_comment: Hunter Kael — side & repeatable quests. Order: reports first, then reminders, then offers (run offer is the catch-all).

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Three scouts down. Clean work — the barrens will feel that for a season.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Your coin, and a potion besides. Stay sharp out there.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Four emberlings, ash to ash. Here's your pay — and if more crawl out of the cinders, you know where to find me.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: The scouts run in the tan barrens, west and north. Fast little devils — wait for their lunge, then roll behind and cut.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Emberlings hatch near the grasslands' edge. Four of them and you've earned your coin.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: You've got the look of someone who's used a blade. Good. I could use one more pair of hands.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Barrens scouts have been shadowing our foragers. Three of them, dead, and I'll make it worth your while.

4.speaker: Hunter Kael
4.text: Good. Tan barrens, west and north. Bring back the tale if not the tails.

1.speaker: Hunter Kael
1.text: Emberlings keep crawling out of the ash near the grasslands. Vermin, but they bite.

2.speaker: Hunter Kael
2.text: Cull four of them and I'll pay you. And again, if they keep coming. Always do.
